collection.description: After several mornings of nausea, a father learns from the healer that he is expecting a child.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After several mornings of nausea, (name1), a father, learns from the healer that he is expecting a child. He sits beside the hospital, considering what he wants and whom he trusts with the news.

choices.label: Ask the Healer About His Options

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They listen, ask what he wants, and make plans together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The news unsettles them; they agree to talk again after thinking.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: He receives practical information without pressure to decide immediately.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: He leaves with more questions and arranges another visit.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A quiet walk helps him understand his own feelings.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The uncertainty weighs on him, and he later seeks company.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: His friend offers support without assuming how he feels.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: His friend blurts out an assumption, then apologizes and listens.
